title: Perform controlled Rig Kontrol 3 capture
description: Why this issue exists: decoding raw endpoint 0x81 packets requires real hardware actions in known labeled windows; the user is not currently available to operate the switches and pedal. What needs to be done: run the guided capture command while pressing/releasing each labeled switch and sweeping the expression pedal, then run the analyzer and keep/repeat only captures with no missing intended control windows.
acceptance_criteria: Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl exists from a guided run; analyzer output is recorded; each intended switch/toe/expression window has packets; missing expected steps are either resolved by repeating capture or explicitly documented as intentionally unavailable.
notes:
Exact commands: swift run rk3probe --guided-capture --step-seconds 2 --capture-log Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl; then swift run rk3probe --analyze-capture Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl. If the user needs more time per step, use --step-seconds 4. Move only the labeled control in each window.
User ran swift run rk3probe --analyze-capture Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl before the capture file existed; analyzer failed with NSCocoaErrorDomain Code=260 no such file. Next action is to run the guided capture command first.
Initial guided capture exists at Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl and analyzes cleanly for structure: 26 records, all 12 expected steps, no missing windows. It is inconclusive for decoding: baseline-changing offsets are 0 and 6, and every switch/toe/expression step reports candidate offsets: none beyond baseline. Repeat with swift run rk3probe --guided-capture --step-seconds 4 --capture-log Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl and hold each switch through the full labeled window.
Second guided capture at Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl has 343 records, all 12 steps, no missing windows. Evidence: length-8 packets with first byte 0x04 carry switch mask in byte 1; length-33 packets with first byte 0x03 carry expression raw value in bytes 5-6 as a 16-bit big-endian value. Observed switch mask bits in labeled windows: switch 1=0x20, switch 3=0x40, switch 4=0x80, switch 5=0x01, switch 6=0x02, switch 7=0x04, switch 8=0x08. Bit 0x10 was observed during baseline and is likely the missing switch 2 but not verified in its labeled window. Switch 9/toe switch did not produce switch-mask evidence; those need follow-up if the hardware has them. Expression raw observed approx 76...628 during movement.
close_reason: Controlled capture was performed and produced enough evidence to implement the packet parser for switch-mask and expression packets; unresolved physical labels are documented for follow-up rather than blocking parser implementation.

title: Clear RK3 LEDs when bridge exits

title: Add Guitar Rig latch switch mode
description: Guitar Rig 6 treats the bridge's current switch noteOn/noteOff output as a momentary gate, so learned effects only stay enabled while a physical switch is held. Add a bridge switch mode that toggles a latched MIDI state on each press and suppresses release output, while preserving an explicit momentary mode for hosts that need press/release behavior. Physical LEDs remain separate because current evidence only verifies USB IN control packets, not LED OUT commands.
close_reason: Added latch, momentary, and trigger switch modes; rk3bridge now defaults to latch mode for Guitar Rig effect toggles; documented LED protocol as separate unverified USB OUT work.

title: Implement live Rig Kontrol MIDI bridge
description: The current SwiftPM code can probe the device, capture packets, analyze logs, parse verified controls, and construct CoreMIDI messages, but it does not yet provide a long-running command or app that streams Rig Kontrol 3 control events into a CoreMIDI virtual source for DAW use.
acceptance_criteria: A runnable bridge command or app opens the Rig Kontrol 3 USB bulk endpoint, continuously parses packets with RigKontrolPacketParser, maps verified events through RigKontrolMapping, publishes them through CoreMIDIVirtualSource, handles clean shutdown, and documents the exact launch command.
close_reason: Implemented rk3bridge live CoreMIDI bridge, streaming USB bulk reader, parser-to-MIDI pipeline tests, launch docs, and successful bounded hardware smoke test.

title: Verify remaining Rig Kontrol controls
description: Why this issue exists: the parser now decodes the verified packet format, but the latest capture did not verify switch 2 in its labeled window and did not show switch-mask evidence for switch 9 or the toe switch. What needs to be done: run focused captures for switch 2, switch 9, and the toe switch if present, then update the parser switch bit map only for controls with clear evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Focused capture evidence identifies whether bit 0x10 is switch 2; switch 9 and toe switch are either mapped from clear switch-mask packets or documented as not present/not exposed; parser tests are updated for any newly verified bits.
close_reason: Focused capture Captures/rk3-remaining-controls.jsonl recorded 103 records across all 4 focused steps. Switch 2 emitted mask 0x20, not 0x10; switch 9 emitted mask 0x00 only; toe switch emitted no switch-report packet. No new default parser mappings were added; README and Research document the evidence and unmapped controls.

title: Add guided capture signal quality hints
description: Why this issue exists: the first full guided capture had all expected steps but no switch/toe/expression-specific byte changes beyond baseline drift, so an analyzer summary can look complete while still being inconclusive for decoding. What needs to be done: flag candidate offsets that differ from steady baseline changes, update the CLI output and tests, and document the stronger repeat-capture guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Analyzer output distinguishes step offsets from steady baseline-changing offsets; tests cover candidate offset detection; docs tell the user to repeat inconclusive captures with longer windows and hold actions.
close_reason: Added baseline-changing offset detection, per-step candidate offsets, CLI output, tests, and updated hold/longer-window capture guidance; verified against the first capture and confirmed it is inconclusive.

title: Add guided capture completeness warnings
description: Why this issue exists: guided capture JSONL logs only contain packet records, so steps with zero packets can disappear from analyzer output and make incomplete captures easy to miss. What needs to be done: extend the analyzer summary to report missing expected guided steps and surface that in rk3probe --analyze-capture.
acceptance_criteria: Analyzer summary lists expected guided steps that have no records; rk3probe --analyze-capture prints missing step warnings; tests cover complete and incomplete capture logs.
close_reason: Added missing expected step summaries to guided capture log analysis, surfaced warnings in rk3probe --analyze-capture, updated docs, and verified with tests plus sparse-log smoke output.

title: Add guided capture log analyzer
description: Why this issue exists: guided JSONL captures preserve labeled packet evidence, but decoding still needs a quick way to summarize which byte offsets changed in each step. What needs to be done: add a pure analyzer for RigKontrol guided capture records and an rk3probe mode that reads a JSONL capture log and reports packet counts, changed packet counts, offsets, and value transitions by step.
acceptance_criteria: Core analyzer groups JSONL records by guided step; summaries include packet counts, changed packet counts, offsets, and transition counts; rk3probe can read a capture log path and print the summary; tests cover the pure analyzer.
close_reason: Added core guided capture log analyzer, rk3probe --analyze-capture offline CLI mode, tests, docs, and smoke verification against a JSONL capture log.

title: Add structured guided capture export
description: Why this issue exists: the guided capture output is readable by humans but harder to parse later, and raw packet decoding will need durable labeled evidence. What needs to be done: add a guided-capture JSON Lines export path that records step labels, packet bytes, timing, and changed offsets without changing the existing human output.
acceptance_criteria: rk3probe guided capture accepts a capture log path; each packet is written as one JSON line with step metadata, packet bytes, and changed offsets; docs show the export command; tests cover the pure record conversion.
close_reason: Added --capture-log JSONL export for guided capture, with structured packet records, tests, documentation, and hardware smoke verification.

title: Add guided Rig Kontrol capture mode
description: Why this issue exists: decoding raw packets still needs physical switch and pedal movement, and unlabeled captures are easy to misread. What needs to be done: add an rk3probe mode that walks through baseline, individual switch press/release windows, toe switch, and expression sweep captures with labeled output so future packet deltas are tied to a known physical action.
acceptance_criteria: rk3probe has a guided capture option with labeled steps and configurable per-step duration; output includes the existing packet delta details under each label; docs explain how to use guided capture for decoding.
close_reason: Added rk3probe --guided-capture with baseline, switches 1-9, toe switch, and expression sweep windows; added configurable --step-seconds, cross-step packet comparison, tests, docs, and hardware smoke verification.

title: Add bulk packet delta output
description: Why this issue exists: raw bulk captures are hard to interpret by eye, and controlled Rig Kontrol 3 testing needs byte-offset deltas to map switch and pedal changes reliably. What needs to be done: add packet analysis that reports packet index, relative time, length, and changed byte offsets against the previous packet, surface it in rk3probe, document the capture format, and cover the pure diff logic with tests.
acceptance_criteria: rk3probe --read-bulk prints packet numbers, relative timestamps, lengths, and changed byte offsets; pure packet-diff behavior is covered by unit tests; docs explain using the output for controlled capture.
close_reason: Added reusable bulk packet diff analysis, surfaced packet delta output in rk3probe, documented zero-based change offsets, and verified with unit tests plus a short hardware capture.

title: Decode Rig Kontrol 3 raw control packets
description: Why this issue exists: the bulk reader receives packets from endpoint 0x81, but byte offsets must be mapped to specific switches and expression values using controlled hardware input. What needs to be done: run controlled captures while pressing each switch and sweeping the pedal, compare packet deltas, document the packet format, and implement a parser that emits RigKontrolControlEvent values.
acceptance_criteria: Controlled captures identify switch bits and expression bytes; parser tests cover switch press/release and expression changes; mapping feeds the existing MIDI message layer.
notes:
Waiting for controlled hardware capture. Workflow: run swift run rk3probe --guided-capture --step-seconds 2 --capture-log Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl while moving each control in its labeled window, then run swift run rk3probe --analyze-capture Captures/rk3-guided.jsonl. The analyzer reports missing expected steps plus offsets/transitions by step; repeat capture if any intended control window is missing before implementing the parser.
Implemented conservative raw packet parser from second guided capture. Verified format: switch reports are 8-byte 0x04 packets with byte 1 as switch bitmask; expression reports are 33-byte 0x03 packets with bytes 5...6 as big-endian raw expression. Default parser maps verified switch bits only: switch 1=0x20, 3=0x40, 4=0x80, 5=0x01, 6=0x02, 7=0x04, 8=0x08. Expression calibration updated to raw 76...628. Analyzer now prints decoded events. Follow-up filed for switch 2/switch 9/toe verification.
close_reason: Decoded the verified raw packet format, added RigKontrolPacketParser, parser/calibration tests, decoded analyzer output, and documentation; unverified controls are split into a follow-up issue.

title: Implement app-level vendor USB event reader
description: Why this issue exists: the attached Rig Kontrol 3 is visible as a vendor-specific USB device but not as HID, MIDI, or CoreAudio. What needs to be done: investigate and implement an app-level USB access path that can configure/open the device, discover interfaces/endpoints, and log raw switch/pedal events without DriverKit if possible.
acceptance_criteria: A probe or bridge component can discover usable USB interfaces/endpoints or document why app-level USB is blocked; raw switch and expression events are logged when access succeeds.
notes: Implemented libusb descriptor and bulk-read probes. Verified app-level USB can open Rig Kontrol 3, enumerate config/interface/endpoints, claim interface 0 alt 0, and receive packets from bulk IN endpoint 0x81. Controlled switch/pedal capture is still required before decoding byte offsets into MIDI control events.
close_reason: Added libusb descriptor probe and bounded bulk reader. Verified device opens, configures, claims interface 0 alt 0, enumerates endpoints, and receives packets from bulk IN 0x81.

title: Implement CoreMIDI virtual source
description: Why this issue exists: DAWs and plugin hosts need a MIDI endpoint to receive Rig Kontrol 3 control events. What needs to be done: implement a CoreMIDI virtual source and message construction for note and CC events.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover note and CC message construction; runtime code can create a stable virtual source name.
close_reason: Added CoreMIDIVirtualSource plus MIDI note/CC message construction and UMP word tests.

title: Scaffold native macOS MIDI bridge
description: Why this issue exists: the first deliverable is a native macOS Apple Silicon MIDI bridge app for Rig Kontrol 3 pedal and switches. What needs to be done: create the Swift project structure, app entry point, hardware abstraction, MIDI abstraction, mapping layer, and documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Project builds locally and exposes separable hardware, mapping, and MIDI modules with documented build commands.
close_reason: Added SwiftPM scaffold with RigKontrol3Core, rk3probe executable, README, research log, and build/test commands.

title: Capture Rig Kontrol 3 hardware facts
description: Why this issue exists: implementation must verify the attached device rather than relying on public samples. What needs to be done: capture macOS, USB, IORegistry, HID, MIDI, and existing driver state for the connected Rig Kontrol 3 before selecting the access path.
acceptance_criteria: Document verified VID/PID, product strings, USB class, interfaces/endpoints when available, HID visibility, MIDI visibility, and current macOS/toolchain versions.
close_reason: Captured and documented local hardware facts in Research/rig-kontrol-3.md; added rk3probe to reproduce USB/HID/MIDI visibility checks.

Recover audio initialization/start/stop ordering, control read and LED sharing, and firmware update gating from named symbols and disassembly. title: Investigate repeatable RK3 audio initialization
description: Follow-up from audio-info probe: first GET_DEVICE_INFO reply was captured and parsed, but repeated GET_DEVICE_INFO calls on alt 1/alt 0 return only automatic 0x03 controller packets despite successful command writes. Verify safe reinitialization/reset or Linux-equivalent startup sequence before sending AUDIO_PARAMS or starting isochronous streaming.
close_reason: Verified Linux-equivalent startup: AUDIO_PARAMS 09 01 02 58 00 01 ACKed with 09 01, and bounded iso IN capture on 0x82 produced completed 88-byte packets after init.

title: Investigate Rig Kontrol LED output protocol
description: The live bridge reads verified controller packets from bulk IN endpoint 0x81, but physical switch LEDs do not light because no USB OUT endpoint 0x01 LED packet format has been verified. Research or capture the LED control protocol before adding any device output writes.
close_reason: Implemented RK3 LED WRITE_IO output from Linux snd-usb-caiaq evidence; verified switch LED 1 lights on attached hardware via led-test; bridge LEDs follow latched switch output by default.

title: Implement control mapping and calibration
description: Why this issue exists: public precedent shows device-dependent expression pedal ranges and DAW-specific mapping needs. What needs to be done: implement configurable switch mappings, expression CC mapping, min/max calibration, clamping, normalization, and jitter suppression.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover calibration min/max, clamping, normalization to 0..127, deadband behavior, and default switch mappings.
close_reason: Added default switch/expression mapping, expression calibration, deadband filtering, and unit tests.

title: Verify native RK3 DIN MIDI with physical loopback

Verify complete channel/system messages, SysEx and realtime in both directions, including reconnect, without confusing Controller endpoints with DIN.
